cap: Precocious puberty means signs before 8 years in girls or 9 years in boys, and LH sorts it. A pubertal LH means the whole axis woke early: central precocious puberty, treated with a continuous GnRH agonist such as depot leuprolide. A suppressed LH means sex steroids come from outside the axis, as in McCune-Albright syndrome, an activating GNAS mutation. A prepubertal LH with near-normal bone age and no growth spurt points to a benign variant.
